description_en: Queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Hybrid cloud traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets
description_zh: 调用GetVbrFlowTopN接口，获取混合云流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序
kebab_example: aliyun nis get-vbr-flow-topn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --begin-time 1638239092000 --end-time 1638239093000 --direction in --group-by 1Tuple --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVbrFlowTopN

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. The maximum time range that you can query is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的毫秒时间戳。最大支持查24小时跨度的数据
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. The maximum time range that you can query is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的毫秒时间戳。最大支持查24小时跨度的数据
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the hybrid cloud traffic in the local regions or for the local IP addresses. Valid values:

in: traffic from a data center to Alibaba Cloud
out: traffic from Alibaba Cloud to a data center
parameters.help_zh:
对于当前地域或IP的流量方向。
in：从IDC访问阿里云。
out：从阿里云访问IDC
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The dimension for ranking hybrid cloud traffic data. The value of this parameter is case-sensitive. Valid values:

1Tuple: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances, CEN connections, virtual border routers (VBRs), and IP addresses.
2Tuple: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the local and remote IP addresses.
5Tuple: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the local and remote IP addresses, local and remote ports, and protocols.
CloudPort: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the local ports.
OtherPort: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the remote ports.
Protocol: queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data for the protocols
parameters.help_zh:
指定混合云流量排名的维度，大小写敏感，注意区分大小写。取值：
1Tuple：查询混合云流量中云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）、连接、改为边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）、IP维度的排名。
2Tuple：查询混合云流量中两端IP维度的排名。
5Tuple：查询混合云流量中两端IP、两端端口和协议维度的排名。
CloudPort：查询混合云流量中云端端口的排名。
OtherPort：查询混合云流量中IDC端端口的排名。
Protocol：查询混合云流量中协议维度的排名
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en: The metric for ranking hybrid cloud traffic data. Default value: Bytes. This value specifies that hybrid cloud traffic data is ranked by traffic volumes
parameters.help_zh: 数据排序的指标。默认值：Bytes，表示按流量排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The order for ranking hybrid cloud traffic data. Valid values:

desc: descending order
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：
desc：降序。
asc：升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: Specifies top-N traffic data to display. Default value: 10. This value specifies that top-10 traffic data is displayed by default. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 展示排序靠前的数据。默认值：10。表示默认展示排序前10的数据。最大100
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VBR that is associated with the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: virtual_border_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol number.

All protocols are supported. This parameter is required only if you set GroupBy to 5Tuple or Protocol
parameters.help_zh:
协议号。
支持全部协议，仅GroupBy配置为5Tuple或Protocol时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The local port.

This parameter is required only if you set GroupBy to CloudPort
parameters.help_zh:
云端端口号。
仅GroupBy配置为CloudPort时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: cloud_port

parameters.help_en:
The remote port.

This parameter is required only if you set GroupBy to OtherPort
parameters.help_zh:
IDC侧端口号。
仅GroupBy配置为OtherPort时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multi-account management feature. Default value: false. This value specifies that the multi-account management feature is disabled.

By default, the multi-account management feature is not available. If you want to use this feature, contact your account manager to apply for permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用多账号管理功能。默认值：false。表示不使用。 
多账号管理功能默认不开放，如需使用，请联系商务经理申请使用权限
parameters.name: use_multi_account

VirtualBorderRouterFlowlogTopN.description_en: The ranking result of hybrid cloud traffic data
VirtualBorderRouterFlowlogTopN.description_zh: 混合云流量详情排名列表

Bytes.description_en: The total volume of traffic in the specified time range
Bytes.description_zh: 指定时间段内的流量总和

CloudRegion.description_en: The local region where the local IP address resides

Packets.description_en: The total number of packets in the specified time range
Packets.description_zh: 指定时间段内的发包数总和

VirtualBorderRouterId.description_en: The ID of the VBR that is associated with the Express Connect circuit
